title: Half-Vector Templates
description: Templates of the half-vectors by mask (`"sw_ldiv_type": "mask"` in the [ISA Descriptor](isa.md)) and of the functions that change the LMUL between `m1` and `d2` (`lo`, `hi`, `combine`, `wcvt`, `ncvt`, and the `_k` mask versions). `helpers_headers/generic_ldiv_mask.json` gives the generic version, used by every ISA; `simd_ext/<isa>/<isa>_ldiv_mask.json` overrides it for one ISA, and is also where the ISAs with `sub_isa` half-vectors (AVX, AVX-512) and with hardware LMUL groups (RVV) write these functions. A function without an entry is written as a lane-wise wrapper of its LMUL 1 version on the same register. The code is Jinja2 and [templating DSL](../templating_dsl.md), rendered for the LMUL of the arguments (`d2`, or `m1` for `lo` and `hi`). Each key is a function name, or several names separated by `|` that share the entries. See [Code Generation](../../internals/code_generation.md#2-one-isa-layer) and [Add an ISA](../../tutorials/add_isa.md#half-vectors-and-functions-that-change-the-lmul).

level.description: Implementation level shown in the generated `// Level` comment, in the summary table and in the documentation. Optional. Without it, the level of an entry of `<isa>_ldiv_mask.json` is detected from its code with the rules of the level audit (0: a single intrinsic, or no instruction at all such as an identity; 1: several intrinsics, or intrinsics and MIPP functions; 2: only MIPP functions), and an entry of `generic_ldiv_mask.json` is level 2. Sequential code (level 3) must be declared with this key.

if.description: C preprocessor condition (e.g. `defined(__SSE4_1__)`) under which this entry is used. Otherwise the next matching entry is used (the entries of `<isa>_ldiv_mask.json` come first, then those of `generic_ldiv_mask.json`), down to an entry without `if`, or the lane-wise wrapper of the LMUL 1 function. `lo` / `hi` / `combine` need a fallback entry without `if` (given by `generic_ldiv_mask.json`).

variants.description: Mask variants the entry applies to (`u`, `m`, `z`, `s`). Omitted: all the variants of the function.

datatypes.description: Datatypes (or `dt_par,dt_ret` pairs for the conversions) the entry applies to, or `all_datatypes` (the default).

code.description: Body of the function, one line per item: Jinja2 and templating DSL (`%vd<tp>%`, `%N<tp|m:tp*2>%`, `%vd<tr>%` for the result). Jinja2 variables: `isa` (the ISA descriptor), `isa_dt` (its entry for the datatype of the arguments), `f` (the function name), `dt` / `dt_ret` (the datatypes of the arguments and of the result, with `category` and `n_bits`), `mask_kind` (`None`, `mask`, `maskz` or `masks`), `UI` (the unsigned datatype of the same width, e.g. `uint32`). Helpers: `call1(name, args..., mk=None, dt=None)` calls the LMUL 1 function `name`, in the mask variant `mk` and for the datatype `dt` (default: the one of the arguments), and records it as a dependency; `wrap(names...)` declares the LMUL 1 copies `w_<name>` of the `d2` parameters; `ret_d2(expr)` returns the LMUL 1 result `expr` as a `d2` result; `lanemask(name)` declares the LMUL 1 mask `name` (default `lm`), true on the lower half of the lanes; `neutral(f)` is the neutral element of the reduction `f`. `ctx` also gives `ctx.dt_par`, `ctx.dt_ret`, `ctx.lmul_in` / `ctx.lmul_out` (LMUL of the arguments and of the result), `ctx.N()` / `ctx.N2()` (the macros of the number of lanes of the full and of the half register) and, for the ISAs whose intrinsics carry the LMUL (RVV), `ctx.ext(dt, lmul)`, `ctx.uext(dt, lmul)` and `ctx.bext(dt, lmul)` (intrinsic suffixes at an LMUL). The generation-time tables of the implementation templates (`compress_lut`, `iota`...) are not available here.

additionalProperties.description: Candidate entries of the function, tried in order (the entries of `<isa>_ldiv_mask.json` first, then those of `generic_ldiv_mask.json`).
